prompts.text: Describe yourself in exactly one sentence. Don't use your name.
Describe a hidden talent without saying what it is.
Describe your role on the team without saying your job title.
Give a clue about something you love, without naming it.
Describe your typical Friday afternoon, vaguely enough to be anyone.
Share one thing that's true about you that the team probably doesn't know.
Describe your desk setup without mentioning any brand.
Give a hint about your favorite snack, without naming it.
Describe your energy at 9 AM in one vivid sentence.
Describe what you'd do with a surprise day off, without naming the activity.
Give a clue about the last thing you binge-watched.
Describe your morning routine in exactly one sentence.
